offers_products.reason: Main offerings are FDA-approved plasma-derived immune globulins ASCENIV, BIVIGAM and Nabi-HB.

offers_services.reason: Contract manufacturing/CDMO is offered but minor next to product sales; patient support hub supports its products.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Products are prescribed and administered by providers and sold via distributors and hospitals, not chosen by households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Buyers are distributors, specialty pharmacies, hospitals and infusion providers; CDMO clients are biopharma companies.

recurring_revenue.reason: Patients with chronic immune deficiency need repeat immune globulin infusions, generating ongoing reorders from distributors and providers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Immune globulin for immune-compromised patients is medically necessary therapy; demand is not easily postponed in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Immune globulin infusions are repeat, per-dose purchases by hospitals, distributors and infusion centers, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured plasma-derived biologic products, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Sells mainly to large distributors, specialty pharmacies and hospitals; payers and insurers fund therapy.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates plasma collection centers (ADMA BioCenters) and a biologics manufacturing plant requiring ongoing heavy investment.

notes: Contract manufacturing (CDMO) and plasma collection are smaller side businesses.
